# La Growth Machine

Save time and focus on closing deals. Automate manual sales rep routines and streamline outreach with multi-channel campaigns.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lagrowthmachine/.

## Actions

- **Create or Update Lead**: Create or update a lead in LaGrowthMachine.
- **Get Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve all campaigns from LaGrowthMachine with pagination support.
- **List Audiences** (read-only): List all audiences in your LaGrowthMachine account.
- **List Identities** (read-only): List all connected identities in your LaGrowthMachine account.
- **List Members** (read-only): List all members (users) associated with your workspace.
- **Search Lead** (read-only): Search for a lead using various criteria.
- **Add RB2B Visitor to Audience**: Add RB2B website visitor to a LaGrowthMachine audience via native webhook.
- **Create Audience from LinkedIn URL**: Import leads into La Growth Machine audiences from LinkedIn URLs.
- **Create Inbox Webhook**: Create an inbox webhook for real-time notifications.
- **Delete Inbox Webhook**: Delete an existing inbox webhook by its ID.
- **List Inbox Webhooks** (read-only): List all inbox webhooks currently configured in your workspace.
- **Register Vector Visitor Webhook**: Register Vector website visitors to a La Growth Machine audience.
- **Remove Lead From Audiences**: Remove a lead from one or more specified audiences in La Growth Machine.
